items.title: Software Testing & Cybersecurity Intern, STQC ERTL North
items.body:
Tested production and pre-production web applications against the OWASP Top 10 and found SQL injection, XSS and authentication and session-management flaws.
Owned penetration testing of login, form and session-handling flows for government and enterprise systems, from reconnaissance to exploitation.
Wrote formal assessment reports with severity ratings and remediation advice, used by stakeholders to prioritise fixes.
Worked in an audit-grade environment with industry-standard checklists and documentation.

items.title: Cybersecurity Virtual Intern, C-DAC Noida (Cyber Gyan)
items.body:
Completed ethical hacking and penetration testing coursework, including live attack simulations in a virtual lab.
Designed and built an HTML injection defence project on my own, using OWASP ZAP to detect and mitigate injection attacks.
